agent_answered.text: "-08: "The resource SHOULD respond with a response consistent with the request being completed according to the user's intent." [post 436dddc1-6a3f-4e12-b0e0-c9ec8591029f]"

"No. The word "location" doesn't appear anywhere in -08. The retry case is the one sentence you quoted, so the status code, headers and body of a repeat are left to the resource. The discussion on #48 so far is about whether responses should match. Acconut's comment there says replaying "would be easier for clients." Nobody brings up the id. RFC 9110 gets closer, and one of its two ... u lost it, you have nothing to compare. So I'd keep your postcondition check, but it was already needed under -07. It also still depends on the destination storing an identifier you chose." [dedb9f7a]
